text: Kere yonaaɓe ɓee lanndiiɓe maandeeji wonnde Men jippinii e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, Alqur'aana hinde janngee e maɓɓe? Wonii e Alqur'anaa jippinaande nden e maɓɓe, yurmeende e waaju wonannde yimɓe gomɗinooɓe; ko kamɓe woni ko nafitorta ko woni e mayre. Men jippinanii ɓe ko ɓuri moƴƴude ko ɓe lanndii kon haa hewta ko jippinanoo e Nulaaɓe ɓen kon.
